apps.name: Kultr Pre
apps.subtitle: Test builds of Kultr, next to the real one.
apps.localizedDescription:
Kultr Pre is the test build of Kultr: new features arrive here first. It installs next to Kultr as its own app, with its own bundle ID, App Group and data, so your Kultr stays as it is.

Kultr is a modern, minimalist client for Navidrome and other Subsonic-compatible servers.

• Your whole library, mirrored on the phone: browsing and search are instant and work offline.
• Two real decks: crossfades with a choice of curves, gapless albums, or a clean cut.
• InjeKt: tracks are analysed on the phone for tempo, beats, key and structure, then blended on the downbeat with a bass swap and a filter sweep, for an endless mix.
• Karousel: tap shuffle twice, and when the queue runs out, music like what was playing keeps coming.
• Downloads for offline listening, at the bitrate you choose.
• Liquid glass on iOS 26, AirPlay, lock screen and Control Center, and a Now Playing widget.
• Every play is sent to your server, so "played recently" is the same on all your devices.
• Stations: endless mixes from your own library by tempo, energy, key, genre or decade, chosen on a glass dial.
• Energy planner: draw how the next hour should feel and get a set that follows the line.
• Search that does things: "play Night Drive", "sleep in 30 minutes", "plan an hour", with Apple Intelligence where it's on.
• Crates, notes and tags, a monthly recap, and Kultr Studio to make the look and the player your own, with widgets on Home.
• Several servers, lyrics, favourites, ratings, playlists, internet radio, equaliser, sleep timer.

Free and open source: github.com/evropiani/Kultr_iOS
apps.versionDescription:
KultrPre is a test build. It installs next to Kultr as a separate app called Kultr Pre, with its own bundle ID (app.kultr.ios.pre), App Group and data. Your Kultr install stays as it is. You'll need to sign in to your server again in Kultr Pre. The in-app update check and the Kultr source never offer test builds.

This build has everything in Kultr 2.0.1 (Stations, the energy planner, crates, Kultr Studio, widgets on Home you can edit), plus:

• German. With the iPhone set to German, or Deutsch chosen for Kultr Pre in the iPhone's Settings → Apps → Kultr Pre → Language, every screen is in German: Settings, the player, Library, Stations, crates, the planner, Kultr Studio, messages, server errors, the Home Screen widget and the Control Center buttons. Settings → Language opens that page.
• Commands in German. Search understands "spiele Nachtfahrt", "zufällig" and an artist, "schlaf in 30 Minuten", "nach diesem Titel stoppen", "weiter", "zurück", "jetzt mischen", "öffne Einstellungen", "zeig meine Kisten" and "plane eine Stunde". English keeps working.
• The starting stations have German names: Aufwärmen, Nachtfahrt, Höhepunkt, Voller Fokus, Runterkommen, Ungehörte Perlen, Favoriten. Stations you made or renamed keep your names.
• The release notes in the update log stay in English.

• Switch Kultr Pre to Deutsch and go through every tab and Settings page. Anything still in English, or German that reads oddly: send a screenshot.
• German commands in Search, and the Home widgets.
• The Home Screen widget, the Lock Screen and Control Center buttons.

Everything from 1.4.1 to 1.4.5 is still here, apart from what's listed as gone below. The What's new page opens once after updating.

• Pulling the player down closes it again, from anywhere.
  • Why it stopped working: the cover's gestures caught the pull. Double-tap, hold and swipe-up each waited for your finger, and the sideways swipe claimed every drag that started on the cover.
  • What's left: the sideways swipe only, and it now lets the sheet see the same drag. Up and down belong to the sheet; clearly sideways still skips.
• Hold Next to mix. Hold the player's Next button and Kultr mixes into the next track over the whole crossfade (at least 2 seconds) instead of cutting. A tap still skips. VoiceOver offers "Mix into the next track" as an action on the button.
• Update log: Settings → About → Update log opens a card with every version, from 1.0.0 to this one, newest first. Each version has its date and what changed. The KultrPre builds since 1.4.0 are there too.
• Gone:
  • The Live Activity. One still showing from an earlier build is ended when Kultr Pre starts.
  • The beat pulse on the play button, and its tapping.
  • "The cover in the player" in Settings → Playback.

• Pulling down: pull the player down starting on the cover, on the title, on the buttons' row and on the queue (scrolled to the top). It should close every time.
• Swipe and hold: swipe the cover sideways to skip, and hold Next to mix.
• Update log: open it, scroll to the bottom, and swipe it closed.

This is the last step before everything goes to Kultr as 1.5.0. Everything from 1.4.1 to 1.4.4 is still here, and the What's new page opens once after updating.

• Kultr Studio: Settings → Kultr Studio has the whole look in one place, with a live preview of the player at the top.
  • Start from a style: Cream (the default), Night (pure black), Ember (dark, colour from the cover, blurred cover behind the player, glowing playhead), Paper (light, sharp corners, compact) or Console (dark, sharp, tempo and key in the info line, the cover at the bottom). A style only changes the look; your library and other settings stay.
  • Colours, shape and glass: theme, night mode, colour from the artwork, corners, cover size, compact rows, the playhead, and clear instead of frosted glass for everything that floats.
  • The player, top to bottom: cover, title, info line, progress and buttons. Switch parts off, or hold a row and drag it to reorder.
  • The info line: write your own with names in braces, like {bpm} BPM{?key: · {key}}. A part in {?key:…} only shows when the track has that value. Tap a name to add it; the "Looks like" line previews it. bpm, key and energy come from InjeKt's analysis.
  • Share: send the style as a link or a file, copy the link, or use one from the clipboard or a file. Opening a kultr://style/… link shows a preview first, with "Use this style" or "Not now".
• Widgets on Home: under the buttons at the top of Home, three to start with: Now playing (medium), This week and Next mix (small).
  • Kinds: now playing (play, skip, tap to open the player), listening this week against your usual, the next mix with a countdown, a station, a crate, or a shortcut that does anything you could type in Search ("shuffle all", "sleep in 30 minutes", your own words).
  • Sizes: small ones sit side by side; medium and large ones go across.
  • Editing: hold a widget and they all wiggle. The minus takes one away, dragging one onto another moves it, "Add a widget" offers the rest, and "Done" stops.

• Studio: try each style, then change a few things and watch the preview. Share the link to yourself (Notes or Messages) and open it: you should see the preview sheet first.
• Player blocks: move the cover to the bottom and switch off the info line. Does the player still pull down and scroll well?
• Widgets: hold one to edit, move a widget, add a station, a crate and a shortcut, and remove one. Do the sizes fit on your screen?

Everything from 1.4.1 to 1.4.3 is still here. The What's new page opens once after updating.

• Energy planner: tap "Plan a set" on Home (or ••• on the Stations page).
  • Draw the shape of the set with your finger, low for calm and high for peak, or start from a shape: Warm up and peak, Steady, Build, Wind down.
  • Choose 30 minutes to 2 hours, and the whole library or one station's music.
  • "Build the set" picks, for each moment, the track whose energy is closest to your line. It also has to mix well out of the one before (close tempo, a neighbouring key), can't be by the same artist and can't repeat. Dots on the drawing show where each track lands.
  • Play it as it is, or save it as a playlist. It only uses tracks InjeKt has analysed; the page says how many are left.
• Command bar: Search also does things. Type a command and an orange row appears above the results; tap it or press Return.
  • Playing: "play Night Drive" (a station), "play" or "shuffle" and an artist or album, "shuffle all", "play" and a crate's name.
  • Controls: "pause", "play", "next", "back", "mix now".
  • Sleep timer: "sleep in 30 minutes", "stop in an hour", "sleep after this song".
  • Pages: "open settings", "show my stations", "open recap", "open" and a crate.
  • Planning: "plan an hour".
• In your own words: with Apple Intelligence on, longer requests the usual phrasings don't cover get an "Ask Kultr to do it" row. Apple's model reads it on the iPhone itself, and nothing is sent anywhere. Without Apple Intelligence, the row doesn't appear.

• Planner: draw a shape, build a set, and look at whether the dots follow your line. Play it: do the mixes hold together?
• Command bar: try the commands above, and some of your own. Tell me what you'd expect to work but doesn't.
• Apple Intelligence: if your iPhone has it, try something like "put on something calm for an hour".

Everything from 1.4.1 and 1.4.2 is still here. The What's new page opens once after updating.

• Crates: folders for albums, artists and tracks, in Library → Crates.
  • By hand: hold an album, an artist or a track anywhere (or use ••• on its page, or select several tracks) and tap Add to crate. The list ticks the crates it's already in; tap a crate again to take it out.
  • By rules: "New crate → Fill it by rules" uses the same rules as stations, plus two new ones: your tags, and when the music was added. It starts as "4 stars and up, added this year".
  • A crate's page plays or shuffles everything in it. ••• renames it, changes its rules, makes a station of the same rules, or deletes it.
  • Keep as a playlist keeps a playlist of the same name on your server with the same tracks, updated a moment after the crate changes. Other apps see it too. Deleting the crate leaves the playlist.
• Notes and tags: album and artist pages have a "Your notes" section above the info text.
  • + Tag adds a tag of your own, and tapping a tag shows everything with it. Hold a tag to remove it.
  • Add a note keeps a note of any length.
  • Library → Tags lists every tag once you've used one. A tag's page can play everything with it, or make it a crate with one tap.
  • Notes and tags are private: they stay on the phone, with your settings, and go into a settings backup (Settings → Backup and reset).
• Glass lens: drag along the player's progress bar and a glass lens floats above your finger. It shows the time large, and eight seconds of the track around it with InjeKt's beats marked: the first beat of each bar is taller and orange, and a planned mix is shaded. Before InjeKt has analysed the track, it shows second marks instead.
• Stations, smaller fixes: the dial has a faint edge in dark mode, and the Home shelf puts stations that have music first. A station with nothing to play yet says why ("Needs InjeKt analysis").

• Crates: add an album, an artist and a few tracks to a crate from their menus, then open it from Library → Crates. Do the covers on the crate's card look right?
• Rules: make a crate by rules and check that its tracks fit.
• Keep as a playlist: switch it on for a crate and look for the playlist in Library → Playlists (pull to refresh), and in another Subsonic app if you use one.
• Notes and tags: tag two albums the same, open the tag from the album page and from Library → Tags, and write a note.
• Lens: does it sit above your finger without covering what you need, and do the beat marks line up with the music?

Everything from 1.4.1 (Rediscover, monthly recap, cover gestures, wind-down, save the session, loading pages) is still here. The What's new page opens once after updating.

• Stations: endless mixes from your own library. A new Stations shelf is added at the top of Home once.
  • Tap a card to start the station, or tap the shelf's title for the Stations page.
  • There, turn the glass dial to choose; it clicks at each station. While a station plays, turning the dial and letting go mixes into the new one after a moment.
  • The starting stations are Warm Up, Night Drive, Peak Hour, Deep Focus, Wind Down, Unplayed gems and Favourites, plus one per decade with at least 20 tracks.
  • Karousel follows the station's rules instead of looking for similar music, and InjeKt picks what mixes best from each track. It keeps going even if Karousel is switched off.
  • Up next shows the station, with an End button. Playing anything else also ends it.
• Your own stations: every station is a set of rules you can edit: tempo, energy (1 to 10), key (Camelot), genres, years, never played, favourites and minimum rating. While you edit, the page counts how many tracks fit.
  • Use ••• to edit, duplicate or delete a station, and "New station" to add one. ••• in the corner brings back the starting set.
  • Tempo, energy and key come from InjeKt's analysis, so those stations only have tracks InjeKt has analysed (or whose tags carry a tempo). The Stations page says how many are left, with an "Analyse the rest" button.
• Live Activity: the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island show the track, its progress, a play/pause button and a countdown to the next mix, like "Beat-matched blend into Paper Moons in 0:12". Before InjeKt has planned the mix (about half a minute before the end), the countdown is an estimate. It starts the next time music starts with Kultr open. Switch it off in Settings → Playback.
• Beat pulse: the play button swells, with a soft orange ring, on the first beat of every bar, once InjeKt has analysed the track. "Tap on the beat" in Settings → Playback makes the phone tap along while the player is open (off at first). With Reduce motion on, it doesn't pulse.

• Stations: start one from Home and from the dial. Does the music fit the name? Turn the dial while it plays, then let go: it should mix into the new station within a few seconds.
• The dial: does it turn smoothly and click once per station?
• Editing: make a station of your own and check that the count changes as you change the rules.
• Live Activity: lock the phone while music plays. Is the countdown right, and does play/pause work from the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island? Does it go away when you stop the music?
• Beat pulse: with a track InjeKt has analysed, does the pulse land on the beat? Try "Tap on the beat" too.

Everything from the Cream look stays as it was. On the first start after updating, a What's new page lists what changed. From now on every update has one.

• Rediscover: a new shelf on Home, after "Albums you keep coming back to". It shows albums you hearted or played at least three times that nobody has played for a year, on the server or on this phone. It's switched on once for you; Settings → Home page removes it or moves it.
• Monthly recap: Listening has a new card at the top that opens a page for this month. It shows how long you listened, plays, tracks and artists, and your top tracks, albums and artists. It also shows your longest day, how many tracks you heard for the first time, and the month before for comparison. The calendar button picks any earlier month. It's made from this phone's own history, because the server only counts plays per track.
• Gestures on the cover: in the player, double-tap the cover to heart the track, hold it to mix into the next one, and swipe up to jump to Up next. Settings → Playback → "The cover in the player" changes each one. The other options are lyrics, play or pause, add to a playlist, or nothing. Swiping sideways still skips.
• Mix now: fades into the next track over the whole crossfade length (at least 2 seconds), instead of skipping. It's a plain crossfade, not a beat-matched InjeKt mix.
• Wind down: with a timed sleep timer, the last 15 minutes put Karousel's calmest picks first: lower energy, slower tempo. The track that's up next and anything you queued yourself stay where they are. It's on by default, with a switch in the sleep timer and in Settings → Playback.
• Save the session: the new button at the top of Up next saves what you've played so far, or the whole queue, as a playlist. You can name it before it's saved.
• Loading and empty pages: pages show grey rows and covers in their real layout while they load, instead of a spinner. Empty pages say why they're empty and what to do, for example "No albums yet" with a Sync button. A filter that matches nothing says so too.

• What's new opens once after installing this over Kultr Pre 1.4.0, and not again after you tap Continue or swipe it away.
• Cover gestures: double-tap, hold and swipe up on the cover. Check that scrolling the player still works when you start on the cover, and that pulling the player down still closes it.
• Mix now: hold the cover in the middle of a track. You should hear a smooth fade into the next one.
• Rediscover: does it show albums you'd forgotten, or nothing at all? If it's empty, tell me roughly how long your server has been counting plays.
• Monthly recap: open it from Listening and try the calendar button.
• Wind down: set a 15-minute sleep timer with Karousel on and look at the order in Up next.
• Loading: open Albums, Artists and Songs right after starting the app.

Kultr's new look, laid out like Apple Music, in orange on cream. Nothing is removed: InjeKt, Karousel, downloads and every setting work as before.

• Colours: cream pages, warm black text and one orange for what you can tap. In dark mode it's warm charcoal with a brighter orange; Night mode is still pure black. There are no gradients anywhere, and the cover is the only colourful thing on screen.
• Glass only where things float: the tab bar, the mini player, the toolbar and player buttons, and sheets. Buttons in pages are solid.
• Text follows Larger Text in the iPhone's settings.
• One spacing scale: every gap is 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 or 32 points. Grids and shelves keep a 16-point margin with 12 points between covers.
• Home: shelf titles open the full list (tap "Played the most ›"). Shuffle all is a sand button; Start an InjeKt set is the one orange one.
• Library: a list of sections (Playlists, Artists, Albums, Songs, Genres, Favourites, Downloads, Radio), then recently added albums. Each section opens as its own page, with a filter field under its title. This replaces swiping between tabs.
• Album, artist and playlist pages: no all-caps label over the title. Play and Shuffle are two sand buttons, and a track's ••• is orange.
• Player: on cream, not on the blurred cover. The year, genre, format, bitrate and rating are one line instead of five pills. Tapping the genre or the rating still works.
• Settings: orange symbols instead of coloured tiles.
• Widgets: cream in light mode, charcoal in dark.
• Icons: orange on cream, plus Ember, Night and Classic in Settings → Appearance → App icon.

The first time Kultr Pre opens, it switches the old defaults to the new ones: periwinkle becomes orange, colour stops coming from the artwork, and the blurred cover behind pages turns off. A colour you picked yourself is kept. Settings → Appearance turns any of them back on.

• Light and dark: look through Home, Library, an album, an artist, a playlist, the player and Settings in both. Anything hard to read, or still showing a gradient or a lot of glass in the page, tell me where.
• Library: open each section from the list and use the filter field. Tapping a Home shelf's title should open the same pages.
• Larger Text: set a bigger text size in iOS Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size and see if anything gets cut off.
• Widgets: add the home screen widget in light and dark mode.
• Appearance: "Colour from artwork", "Blurred artwork background" and the accent colours still work.

Kultr 1.3.9 (with the smooth player) plus new icons.

• The icon is now the K in orange on cream. The logo inside the app, in Settings and on the welcome screen, matches.
• Settings → Appearance → App icon offers four: Cream (the new main one), Ember (cream on orange), Night (orange on black) and Classic (the old blue). Tap one and iOS asks to confirm with a short message, then the home screen icon changes.

• The home screen icon of Kultr Pre is orange on cream after installing.
• Each of the four in Settings → Appearance → App icon changes the home screen icon, and the one you picked stays selected when you come back to the page.
• After re-signing (or reinstalling over it), the icon you picked is kept or falls back to Cream, but doesn't break.
• If your signing app shows an error when you pick an icon, tell me what it says.
